description: Demo comparison on a synthetic task, using the simulated fixture agent (no model, no network). The baseline writes free-form notes; the skill variant reads the release-notes-format skill first and follows it.

task.prompt: Write RELEASE_NOTES.md summarizing notes.md for this release.

verifier.successCriteria: RELEASE_NOTES.md exists and contains the sections Changelog, Known Issues and Roadmap, in that order

baseline.content:
# Release notes

Stuff happened this quarter; see notes.md for everything.

skill.content:
# Release notes

## Changelog

- CSV export button on reports
- Login loop fix for expired cookies
- PDF library upgrade for Cyrillic

## Known Issues

- Slowness on dashboards over 50 widgets
- Random 502s from the edge cache

## Roadmap

- Bulk edit for inventory rows
- Public read-only status API
